backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and client management with access control, user approval system, blob storage, and bulk operations support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting authentication/authorization components (AuthApprovalGate, SignInScreen, ApprovalRequiredScreen, SignInRequiredDialog) and hooks (useApprovalStatus) with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including pages, components, hooks, and styles, describing authentication flows, data management, UI components, and styling approaches.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md: Deployment verification guide with build/deploy commands, critical inventory add item test flow, troubleshooting steps, and in-app diagnostics documentation for verifying successful deployment.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with CSP meta tags allowing connections to IC domains, Internet Identity, and external CDNs for scripts/styles.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages, wrapping them in AuthApprovalGate and AppLayout, and initializing runtime diagnostics.
frontend/src/components/challans/Challan: Dialog component for bulk uploading challans from CSV with file parsing, validation against existing challans, staff permission checks, error display, and upload result reporting.

Dialog component for editing existing challans with form fields for client, venue, dates, freight, and line items. Validates inventory availability, prevents editing returned challans, and handles challan updates via mutation hook.

Dialog component for creating new challans with form inputs for client details, rental dates, and multiple line items. Validates inventory quantities in real-time and submits new challan data via create mutation hook.

Dialog for bulk uploading challans from CSV files in a new format. Parses and validates CSV data, enforces staff permissions, displays parse errors or success results, and creates multiple challans via bulk mutation.

Dialog for restoring challan rent and return dates from original CSV files. Supports both legacy and new CSV formats, validates permissions, parses CSV data, and updates challan dates via restore mutation.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientBu: Dialog for bulk uploading clients from CSV files with template download support. Parses CSV with client names, validates for duplicates and required fields, and creates multiple clients via bulk mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/common/AppErrorB: React error boundary component that catches render errors and displays a fallback UI with expandable technical details, diagnostics report copying, and a reset button to reload the application.
frontend/src/components/common/ApprovalR: Full-page screen for authenticated but unapproved users, allowing them to request approval, view their principal ID, sign out, and auto-refreshes approval status every 5 seconds.
frontend/src/components/common/AuthAppro: Global authentication gate that blocks routes until users are authenticated and approved/admin, with auto-bootstrap for admin domains and loading states during identity initialization and permission checks.
frontend/src/components/common/BuildInfo: Sheet component displaying build metadata, backend connection diagnostics, real-time health monitoring, manual connection/auth testing, and access to comprehensive diagnostics reports with troubleshooting guidance.
frontend/src/components/common/BulkUploa: Reusable UI components for bulk upload workflows including steps display, template download button, validation button, and preview section showing valid items and errors with scrollable error list.
frontend/src/components/common/Diagnosti: Dialog component that displays a formatted diagnostics report in a read-only textarea with options to copy to clipboard or clear the diagnostic log.
frontend/src/components/common/ModalSele: Wrapper around SelectContent that ensures proper scrolling, z-index handling, and collision detection when select dropdowns are used inside modal dialogs, preventing click-through and scroll issues.
frontend/src/components/common/QueryErro: Reusable error state component for query failures that displays classified error messages, troubleshooting steps, technical details in collapsible sections, and provides retry/sign-in actions based on error type.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInReq: Dialog component that prompts users to authenticate via Internet Identity before performing restricted actions, with loading states during login.
frontend/src/components/common/SignInScr: Full-page sign-in screen that guides users through Internet Identity authentication with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Dialog for bulk uploading inventory items via CSV with file parsing, validation, error reporting, staff permission checks, and template download functionality.
Dialog form for adding or editing individual inventory items with validation, mutation gating, authentication checks, and error handling that prompts sign-in when unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header navigation, admin-only access management link, sign-out functionality, and footer; skips layout rendering for print routes.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Dialog for bulk uploading payments via CSV with parsing, validation against existing payments, staff permission checks, error reporting, and template download.

Dialog component for adding new payment records with fields for payment ID, date, client selection, payment mode, amount, reference number, and site. Uses React Hook Form and integrates with useAddPayment mutation to submit payment data.
frontend/src/components/petty-cash/Petty: Component for managing petty cash attachments (images and PDFs) with upload, display, and removal functionality. Handles file validation (type and size), converts files to ExternalBlob format, and manages both local uploading state and server-stored attachments.

Dialog for bulk uploading petty cash records via CSV file with template download, file parsing/validation, and batch import functionality. Includes staff permission checks, error reporting per row, and displays upload results with success/failure counts.

Form dialog for creating or editing petty cash records with fields for date, balances, expenses, staff advances, and dynamic category expenses. Includes automatic cash received calculation, closing balance computation, attachment management, and PDF generation/printing capability.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccessManagement.t: Custom React Query hooks for admin access management including checking admin status, listing user approvals, and setting approval statuses. Provides derived lists for pending and approved users with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Core hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Handles actor initialization with admin token, manages query caching, and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithConnectio: Provides a hook for creating an anonymous actor with connectivity probing, exponential backoff retry logic (up to 5 attempts), connection state tracking, and diagnostics including response times and success/failure counts.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppMode.ts: Detects whether the app is running on the admin domain (containing '-x18') or staff domain based on hostname, returning mode flags and logging diagnostic information for domain-specific troubleshooting.
frontend/src/hooks/useApprovalStatus.ts: Provides hooks to check if the current user is approved or admin, with auto-refetch for pending users, and a mutation hook to request approval with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrapAdmin.ts: Provides a mutation hook to manually retry bootstrapping the current user as admin, invalidating approval-related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flows, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options including derivation origin support.
frontend/src/hooks/useMutationGate.ts: Provides a shared hook that gates mutations based on actor readiness and authentication status, returning detailed state including reasons for blocking and user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all React Query hooks for CRUD operations on inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, clients, and build metadata, including bulk operations, dashboard metrics calculations, and cache invalidation logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueryDataVersion.t: Helper hook that derives a serializable version string from React Query cache metadata (dataUpdatedAt) to enable derived queries to recompute when underlying data changes without including BigInt values in query keys.
Returns staff mode restrictions based on app mode and admin status, determining whether bulk upload and delete operations are allowed with appropriate disabled reasons.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayKey.ts: Returns a stable per-day key (YYYY-MM-DD) that automatically updates at midnight, used to trigger date-aware React Query invalidation and recomputation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors using OKLCH color space, and includes comprehensive modal/dialog opacity fixes for Radix UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
Admin-only page for managing user access approvals, displaying pending and approved users with actions to approve or reject access requests.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed view of a single challan with options to edit, delete, or print; prevents modifications to returned challans and enforces staff restrictions on delete operations.
frontend/src/pages/ChallanPrintPage.tsx: Print-optimized page that displays challan details in a formatted layout and automatically triggers the browser print dialog after rendering.
frontend/src/pages/ChallansPage.tsx: Main challans listing page with table view, supporting create, bulk upload, mark as returned actions, and enforcing authentication and staff permission restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/ClientBalancesPage.ts: Displays a table of client balances showing total rent, payments, outstanding amounts, and advances for each client. Fetches data using useClientBalances hook and formats currency values.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing daily, monthly, and all-time metrics including revenue, challan counts, payments (cash/online), pending amounts, expenses, and inventory status. Uses useInventory and useDashboardMetrics hooks to fetch and display data in metric cards.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Manages rental inventory items with CRUD operations, displaying a table of items with quantities (total, issued, available) and daily rates. Includes dialogs for adding/editing items and bulk upload functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentsPage.tsx: Displays and manages payment records in a table showing date, client, payment mode, amount, and reference number. Includes staff restrictions for bulk upload and a form dialog for adding new payments.
frontend/src/pages/PettyCashPage.tsx: Tracks daily petty cash transactions showing opening/closing balances, cash from MD, expenses, staff advances, and handovers. Supports PDF generation for records and bulk upload with staff restrictions.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Comprehensive reporting page with filters for date ranges (daily/monthly/custom), clients, sites, and status. Displays challans, payments, and petty cash data in tabs with Excel export functionality and date validation.
frontend/src/utils/challanExportTemplate: Builds challan export data as a 2D array with headers and item-level rows, repeating challan-level fields (ID, client, venue, dates, freight, total, status) for each item in the challan.
frontend/src/utils/challanImport.ts: Parses legacy challan CSV format with one item per row (Challan ID, Client Name, Venue, Item Name, Quantity, Rate, Start Date, End Date, Freight), validates fields, groups items by challan ID, and returns valid Challan objects with errors.
frontend/src/utils/challanImportNewForma: Parses new challan CSV format with one challan per row and multiple items in a single 'Items' column, supporting both parentheses format (ItemName(qtyxratexdays)) and colon format (ItemName:Quantity:Rate), calculates rental days from rent/return dates.
Parses challan restore CSV for date restoration, supporting both legacy (Start Date/End Date) and new (Rent Date/Return Date) formats, validates dates, calculates numberOfDays, and returns minimal Challan objects with only ID and date fields.
frontend/src/utils/challanTotals.ts: Provides shared calculation utilities for challan totals: item total (quantity × rate × rental days), challan total (items total + freight), and form-based calculations for create/edit dialogs.
frontend/src/utils/clientImport.ts: Parses client CSV (single 'Name' column), validates client names are non-empty and unique against existing clients and within the file, returns valid Client objects with creation timestamps and detailed error messages.
frontend/src/utils/csv.ts: Generic CSV parser that handles standard quoting rules including commas and newlines inside quoted fields, escaped quotes (double quotes), UTF-8 BOM stripping, and CRLF normalization, returning headers and rows as string arrays.
frontend/src/utils/dashboardMetrics.ts: Calculates dashboard metrics (revenue, payments, expenses, cash in hand) for given time periods, filtering challans by rent date and payments by creation date, with separate logic for future metrics.
frontend/src/utils/dates.ts: Provides date utility functions for converting between JavaScript Date objects and bigint nanosecond timestamps, including parsing, normalization, date arithmetic, and formatting.
frontend/src/utils/diagnosticsReport.ts: Generates comprehensive diagnostics reports tracking authentication events, backend connection probes, response times, and browser capabilities with troubleshooting guidance.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Classifies errors into categories (actor-unavailable, authorization, network, timeout, etc.) and provides normalized error messages with troubleshooting steps.
frontend/src/utils/exportToCSV.ts: Provides functions to download CSV templates for inventory, challans, payments, petty cash, and clients with predefined headers.
frontend/src/utils/exportToExcel.ts: Exports report data (challans, payments, petty cash, client balances, summary) to Excel format using dynamically loaded SheetJS library with multiple worksheets.
frontend/src/utils/paymentImport.ts: Parses and validates payment CSV files, checking for duplicate IDs, valid dates, required fields, and numeric amounts. Returns validated Payment objects and error messages with row numbers.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashImport.ts: Parses and validates petty cash CSV files with required columns (date, opening balance, cash from MD, expenses, etc.), checks for duplicate dates, and parses category expenses. Returns validated PettyCash records and errors.
frontend/src/utils/pettyCashPdf.ts: Generates PDF documents for petty cash records using pdf-lib loaded from CDN. Creates formatted A4 pages with tables showing opening balance, transactions, net change, and closing balance.
frontend/src/utils/reportExportFormatter: Provides shared formatting helpers for Excel exports including date conversion from nanoseconds, currency formatting, text normalization, and short date display (DD-MMM-YY).
frontend/src/utils/runtimeDiagnostics.ts: Tracks runtime diagnostics including actor initialization, authentication lifecycle, connection probes, and errors. Logs events to sessionStorage with context (user agent, path, auth status) for troubleshooting deployment and authentication failures.
frontend/src/utils/safeSerialize.ts: Provides safe JSON serialization helpers that convert BigInt to strings to prevent serialization errors. Includes functions for stringifying values and extracting error details safely.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support. Includes functions to get, store, clear, and remove parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color tokens using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings including container, border radius, shadows, and accordion animations, with typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking Rentiq Udaipur equipment rental system, documenting the need to revert from version 77 (public/no-auth) back to version 71 (Internet Identity authentication with admin approval workflows and role-based access control).
